import Std

namespace NearCharacterRank

def xorSum : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | value :: rest => Nat.xor value (xorSum rest)

theorem linear_zero_on_xorSum (test : Nat → Bool)
    (zero : test 0 = false)
    (linear : ∀ a b, test (Nat.xor a b) = Bool.xor (test a) (test b))
    (values : List Nat)
    (vanishes : ∀ value ∈ values, test value = false) :
    test (xorSum values) = false := by
  induction values with
  | nil => simpa [xorSum] using zero
  | cons value rest ih =>
      have hv : test value = false := vanishes value (by simp)
      have hrest : ∀ item ∈ rest, test item = false := by
        intro item hm
        exact vanishes item (by simp [hm])
      change test (Nat.xor value (xorSum rest)) = false
      rw [linear value (xorSum rest), hv, ih hrest]

theorem sampled_basis_forces_linear_zero
    (samples : List Nat) (witnesses : Fin 40 → List Nat)
    (cert : ∀ bit : Fin 40, xorSum (witnesses bit) = 2 ^ (bit.val + 1))
    (members : ∀ bit : Fin 40, ∀ value ∈ witnesses bit, value ∈ samples)
    (test : Nat → Bool)
    (zero : test 0 = false)
    (linear : ∀ a b, test (Nat.xor a b) = Bool.xor (test a) (test b))
    (sample_zero : ∀ value ∈ samples, test value = false) :
    ∀ bit : Fin 40, test (2 ^ (bit.val + 1)) = false := by
  intro bit
  rw [← cert bit]
  apply linear_zero_on_xorSum test zero linear (witnesses bit)
  intro value hv
  exact sample_zero value (members bit value hv)

def witnessX (bit : Fin 40) : List Nat := (witnessListsX.toArray)[bit.val]!

theorem certificateX : ∀ bit : Fin 40, xorSum (witnessX bit) = 2 ^ (bit.val + 1) := by decide

theorem membersX : ∀ bit : Fin 40, ∀ value ∈ witnessX bit, value ∈ samplesX := by decide

theorem no_extra_linear_equalityX (test : Nat → Bool)
    (zero : test 0 = false)
    (linear : ∀ a b, test (Nat.xor a b) = Bool.xor (test a) (test b))
    (sample_zero : ∀ value ∈ samplesX, test value = false) :
    ∀ bit : Fin 40, test (2 ^ (bit.val + 1)) = false :=
  sampled_basis_forces_linear_zero samplesX witnessX
    certificateX membersX test zero linear sample_zero

def witnessInverse (bit : Fin 40) : List Nat := (witnessListsInverse.toArray)[bit.val]!

theorem certificateInverse : ∀ bit : Fin 40, xorSum (witnessInverse bit) = 2 ^ (bit.val + 1) := by decide

theorem membersInverse : ∀ bit : Fin 40, ∀ value ∈ witnessInverse bit, value ∈ samplesInverse := by decide

theorem no_extra_linear_equalityInverse (test : Nat → Bool)
    (zero : test 0 = false)
    (linear : ∀ a b, test (Nat.xor a b) = Bool.xor (test a) (test b))
    (sample_zero : ∀ value ∈ samplesInverse, test value = false) :
    ∀ bit : Fin 40, test (2 ^ (bit.val + 1)) = false :=
  sampled_basis_forces_linear_zero samplesInverse witnessInverse
    certificateInverse membersInverse test zero linear sample_zero

#print axioms NearCharacterRank.certificateX
#print axioms NearCharacterRank.certificateInverse
#print axioms NearCharacterRank.no_extra_linear_equalityX
#print axioms NearCharacterRank.no_extra_linear_equalityInverse

end NearCharacterRank
